help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Gives the slotted power a chance to Heal yourself 10% of your max life, and reduces the power's recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%.  This effect will be triggered roughly 5 times per minute
power_display_names: Superior Vampire's Bite: Recharge/Chance to Heal Self
power_short_helps: Increases Recharge, Chance to Heal Self
